entity_type_note: This institute code is the UNIVERSITY itself, not an affiliated college - in your cutoff data it appears because a handful of courses (e.g. Food Technology, Oil and Paints Technology, Petro Chemical Engineering) run directly as University Departments rather than at a constituent college. Worth flagging in your schema as entity_type: 'university_department' vs 'college' so downstream logic (e.g. placement-cell lookups) doesn't treat it like an ordinary engineering college.

established_year.detail: Established 1 May 1983 (Maharashtra Day); known as Amravati University until renamed Sant Gadge Baba Amravati University in 2005

approved_by.value: UGC, AICTE; recognised under Section 12(B) of the UGC Act

naac_grade.source: https://sgbau.ac.in/ (search snippet, current site banner) and https://www.collegebatch.com/2905-sant-gadge-baba-amravati-university-in-amravati
naac_grade.agreement: consistent across the two most specific sources; one older Wikipedia mention only notes accreditation was first received in 2002 without a current grade, which is not a conflict, just older/less specific

jurisdiction.value: Covers five districts of western Vidarbha: Amravati, Akola, Yavatmal, Buldhana, Washim; roughly 413 affiliated colleges
